frame: metres, origin on the ground under the middle unless the kind's notes say otherwise, Blender -Y is the front, Z up; seats [x, y, z, yaw]: yaw = degrees of the sitter's facing, counter-clockwise seen from above, 0 = toward the object's front (-Y); size and bounds are in Blender axes (x, y, z)
asset_names: SM_South_<Kind>[_V<n>] (_V only for kinds with several variants)
atlas: M_North_Atlas (the North's, blender/north/gen); text slots M_South_Text_<id> from textures/localized/<lang>/south_<id>.png

meshes.notes: the lighthouse's rotating Fresnel lens, a separate mesh: its origin is the lens' centre on the rotation axis (Z up) and it stands in the tower's lantern with the origin at the tower manifest's `lamp` (z 21.71 in the tower's frame): everything lies between z -0.79 (the clockwork drum's foot on the lantern floor) and z +0.775 (the cap's underside is z +0.79) and inside r 0.625 (the glazing's vertex radius is 1.14). Frame brass (the kit's yellow swatch) and black: a clockwork drum (r 0.52), an octagonal drum of eight panels (apothem 0.55, z +-0.28) with a bullseye on local +X and on -X (the two beams; a shallow square pyramid each, UV corners 0..1 with the centre at UV (0.5, 0.5), so a material's radial rings come out round) and six plain refracting panels, three prism rings above and two below (16 panels each), a brass cap, the mantle on its stem. Every glass panel is its own quad UV 0..1 in the slot M_South_LensGlass (a game material: glass; the frame is atlas tiles). No collision

the lighthouse beam, the cheap one: two cones along +X and -X from the origin (the lens' centre), each of three flat cards crossed at 60 degrees about the X axis (6 quads), 1.0 m long (the engine scales X), half-width 0.01 m at the origin growing to 0.06 m at the end. UV: U 0 at the origin to 1 at the far end, V 0..1 across the card. One slot M_South_Beam (the game makes it unlit, additive, two-sided), no atlas, no collision

a whitewashed picket fence segment 2.4 m long along local X, origin at its middle on the ground, the pickets on the front (-Y) side (the rails and the posts behind); posts bedded 0.25 m (nothing else under ground). Atlas tiles: white paint, a little wood and black iron. plain: 17 pickets 0.07 wide, 0.98 m high, two rails (z 0.30 and 0.78), two posts (x +-1.1, to z 1.12 with a cap). Collision: box (collision_boxes: one slab 2.4 x 0.14 x 1.0 m for the plain one)

a whitewashed picket fence segment 2.4 m long along local X, origin at its middle on the ground, the pickets on the front (-Y) side (the rails and the posts behind); posts bedded 0.25 m (nothing else under ground). Atlas tiles: white paint, a little wood and black iron. with a closed gate in place of the pickets between the posts: a leaf of 15 pickets with an arched top (z 1.07 in the middle, 0.93 at the sides), two rails and a diagonal brace, strap hinges on the -X post, a latch bar and keeper on the +X post. Collision: the two posts only, the leaf is not solid (the gate is the way in; the hero walks through). Collision: box (collision_boxes: one slab 2.4 x 0.14 x 1.0 m for the plain one)

a Stevenson screen with the keeper's weather things, front -Y. The screen: a white louvred wooden box 0.6 x 0.5 m, underside z 1.25, walls to z 1.82 (louvred sides and back, a louvred door with a knob and hinge straps on the front, a dark core behind the louvres), an eave slab and a low gable on top (top z 1.94), on four legs bedded 0.25 m with a low brace. On the front +X leg (x 0.27) a small tin case (z 0.82..1.08) with a catch and its lid, the log book (red cover, white label) hanging on a cord at its side. A rain gauge 0.8 m to +X (a post, a tin cylinder 0.12 m wide with a funnel, top z 0.95). A thin white mast at x 1.3, y 0.3, 2.5 m high, with a compass cross and a wind vane. Origin on the ground under the screen's middle. read_at = where the hero stands to read the log (in front of the case, facing it). Collision: box (collision_boxes): the screen, four legs, the gauge, the mast
